settings.languageTooltip:
Which language this mod shows.
Follow the game uses whatever the game is set to, and falls back to English where a string has not been translated.

Non-Latin alphabets need CET set to a matching font language in its own config.

Right-click to reset.
settings.leaveEmptyToUseGeneric: Leave empty to use generic name.
settings.logLevelTooltip:
How much this mod writes to the CET console and its log file.

Off - nothing
Error - only failures, such as a save that did not write
Warn - failures plus problems worth knowing about (default)
Info - what the mod is doing, one line per action
Debug - everything, including one line per imported location

Dumps and export confirmations always print.
Right-click to reset.
